role: trellis-check: bounded independent KNOWLEDGE frontend verification

canonical_test_selection.selection: Current Core/Views knowledge guides plus existing P4 captured test paths; all existing knowledge-named canonical files, excludes account-route test, component mount/composition suites, locale parity suite and all stage-approvals/client3d matrices.

selection_basis: Existing task P4 test receipts, reconciled against every current knowledge-named Core/Views test file
excluded_execution: PAY S2 Go work and races
component mount/composition suites and locale parity suite
API/DB/model/account or application process lifecycle operations
scope.lint_scope: Existing installed ESLint/configurations, 24 Core and 10 Views knowledge source/test files only
scope.cache_handling: Supported Vitest --cache=false prevents result-cache writes; no cache deleted or pruned.

source_input_binding.definition: Complete non-output repository source/config/assets in the transitive Core/Views workspace dependency closure, all workspace package manifests and root TS/Vitest/ESLint/pnpm/workspace configs/lockfiles, every input file read by the unchanged Core/Views TypeScript compiler programs, installed direct dependency manifests/links and local command shims, installed node/pnpm/tsc executables. Private manifests retain every path, full SHA-256, filesystem mode, symlink target, bytes and timestamps.

normalization_reconciliation.explanation: TypeScript strips the installed declaration’s existing leading UTF-8 BOM. Before/after raw bytes, mode and timestamps each match; before/after compiler text hashes each match; stripping only EF BB BF exactly reproduces both compiler text hashes. No source mutation was observed.

tools.environment: Explicit ordinary runtime environment allowlist; no API/DB/model/account credentials passed to checks.
tools.package_manager_warning: Original stderr retains pnpm warning that root package.json pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies/pnpm.overrides keys are ignored. No config edited.

findings.statement: No source-local failure was observed in the selected knowledge tests, canonical package typechecks or scoped knowledge lint. No source/config code was changed. The raw harness BOM discrepancy is explained by a supplementary receipt without changing its original result.

retained_evidence.commands_and_stdout_stderr: Each actual check has a .command.json, separate unmodified .stdout.log/.stderr.log, raw exit result and input-bound result in the unique private directory.

handoff.reason: All assigned frontend commands pass without code changes. Main session owns complete ROOT integration and AC/product acceptance. This receipt grants no source readiness/freeze and does not validate PAY S2, runtime, E2E or product scenarios.
